params.body:
The dashboard's part of reading the Observatory with a gentells.com account (design: gentells-pipeline `docs/design/one-account.md`; the site and pipeline parts are separate PRs).

- **Login:** "Log in with gentells.com" above the password form, shown only when `/auth/site/config` answers. Authorization code with PKCE (S256) and a state, both in sessionStorage (`src/siteAuth.js`). The password form stays for the team.
- **`/auth/callback`:** checks the state, exchanges the code through `POST /auth/site`, signs in. A mismatch, a cancelled sign-in or a refusal is said in plain words with a way back.
- **Guest:** `useAuth()` gives `isGuest` and `canWrite`; the allowed routes are in `src/guest.js`. The menu shows Overview, Insights, Patterns and, under Data, Signals, Concepts, Foresight, Standard, Atlas; no System, Ask or Studio. Any other route sends a guest to `/`, checked on the page the router renders, so a typed `/accounts` never mounts the Accounts page. Writing controls on the allowed pages are hidden for a guest (insight edit and publish, the review queue, Standard proposals, the Overview's team sections). The server is the boundary; this keeps dead buttons out of sight.
- **Accounts:** a guest row shows Guest.

Checks: build, lint ratchet (22, at the ceiling), e2e 43 of 43, including `e2e/site-login.spec.js` (8): the authorize query, no button without config, state mismatch refused, the exchange and sign-in, a refusal shown, the guest menu, guest redirects without leaked requests.
params.title: Log in with gentells.com, and a read-only Observatory for guests
